item.content:encoded:
That comment sounds author-y so I'm going to address you as such. My only beef with this is the data expunged that happens to that 23%. In my opinion at least, it seems more like a cop-out that means "something t-t-t-teeerrrribble" in this case, instead of actually leaving out something that's thought out. That's what I assume when I run into one mid-sentence like a concrete wall. Or, more appropriately, a concrete wall with what I thought was a door but turned out to be painted on by that wascawwy wabbit.

Not saying you didn't think anything up for that part, but from what I've heard it's not only a good idea to know what you're leaving out, but to give part of the picture. And by part of it I mean just a few words beyond what's there now, short and sweet and full of the WAIT WHAT feeling that I (and I believe others as well) love so much.

edit: derp, this is supposed to be a reply to Hidenozuke. If it already is, well, I can't tell on my phone.
